Appraiser remarks
The rear bumper cover is cracked and displaced, with the trunk lid edge and both
taillight assemblies showing impact deformation consistent with the reported rear-end
collision. Damage to the quarter panel and the rear crossmember is limited and follows
the energy path expected from this type of strike. Nothing in the vehicle's codnition
suggests prior unrepaired damage in these areas. The proposed plan replaces the bumper
cover, taillight assemblies and trunk lid, and includes straightening the crossmember
bracket and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours requested match the scope
of these repairs, and the parts list shows no duplicated line items. Recommend
approval as submitted, with supplements only if hidden damage appears during teardown.
